name: Verify
description: Checking the source against the verifiable part of the specification, and answering what was found.

scenarios.title: Code that drifted from its glossary
given: a glossary declaring a word one of its terms rejects
a comment in scope using that word
scenarios.then: one finding is reported for the line the word appears on

scenarios.title: The same run from a subdirectory
given: a project whose source has drifted from its glossary
scenarios.when: `sumi verify` runs from a subdirectory of that project
scenarios.then: the same findings answer with paths relative to where the run started

scenarios.title: A specification the configuration switched off
given: a .sumi.json declaring the glossary is not to be verified
source that has drifted from that glossary
scenarios.then: the switched-off specification contributes no findings

scenarios.title: Every declared behavior is claimed
given: a behavior specification whose every scenario is claimed by source in scope
scenarios.then: no difference is reported between the two sides

scenarios.title: A scenario nothing claims
given: a behavior specification with a scenario no source in scope claims
scenarios.then: the scenario is reported at the line of the specification that declares it, naming the scope that was searched

scenarios.title: A claim resolving to no scenario
given: source claiming an id no behavior specification declares
scenarios.then: the claim is reported at the line it sits on as resolving to no scenario

scenarios.title: Source the grammar cannot read
given: a Ruby file in scope the grammar cannot parse
scenarios.then: the file is named as one the grammar could not read rather than reported as agreeing

scenarios.title: No specification to verify from
given: a directory with no specification root

scenarios.title: A root the configuration points at but nothing wrote
given: a .sumi.json naming a root no one created
scenarios.then: that root is named as the specification that is not there

scenarios.title: A clone that arrived without the empty behavior directory
given: a project whose behavior directory git did not carry

scenarios.title: A mechanism that could not be read does not silence the others
given: a project whose glossary names a file the grammar cannot parse
a scenario in the same project that no source in scope claims
scenarios.then: the unclaimed scenario is reported alongside the file that could not be read
